about:
Central Plains Industries LLC operates a metal fabrication shop in Clark, South Dakota, roughly 20 miles west of Watertown. The company was founded in 2001. No founders or ownership details are disclosed.

The facility spans over 120,000 square feet and houses a full range of metalworking capabilities under one roof. Cutting services include laser, plasma, and band saw cutting. Fabrication equipment covers press brakes, benders, a corner notcher, powered shear, sheet metal roller, turret punches, and a powered sheet metal punch with a large tooling selection. Machining centers feature twin-spindle, twin-turret configurations with live milling and robotic part unloading, controlled by Siemens CNC systems. Welding capabilities encompass line, spot, robotic, TIG, and MIG processes. Finishing options include liquid painting, undercoating, and powder coating for industrial and automotive applications. The company employs a dedicated workforce, though exact headcount is not public.

Central Plains serves industrial and automotive sectors, along with other markets requiring custom metal fabrication, machining, and finishing. Customers include repeat buyers who value on-time delivery and competitive pricing, as reflected in testimonials from individuals such as Dave Oster, Troy Reil, and a reviewer on MFG.com.

The company states its mission is to be the premier custom fabricator for its markets by creating value and relationships where all succeed. It emphasizes continuous improvement, quality checks at every operation step using Faro Arm, scanner, and digital gauges, and a commitment to delivering parts to the customer's dock on schedule.
